ruleSummary: Measured snow bindings follow M10 observation rules: summit only within 1 mi and 500 ft or pinned KMWN/A4090/A3672/MMNV1; base/valley stations must not sit more than 250 ft above the place; nearby-higher for high summits (e.g. MWN/KMWN at Pinkham/Stowe). Station elevation uses USGS EPQS when NOHRSC table elevation differs by >200 ft. Station catalog is the union of NOHRSC Northeast snowdepth tables over the last 7 days. Runtime shows the latest table row per bound station or “no report in the last 7 days.”
